verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly detail on-reader tipping (reader suggests tip percentages/amounts before payment) and on-receipt tipping, collected before or after authorizing a payment, directly matching the merchant-ops tipping configuration story. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation of configuring specific percentage/smart-amount/custom-tip values in the Dashboard, and no evidence of granular UI screenshots or API parameter details for tip customization.
